newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Brantano IPO price range 1,030-1,200 Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Brantano IPO price range 1,030-1,200 Bfr.

text.p: Belgian shoe distributor Brantano NV said on Wednesday the price range for its June initial public offering was 1,030 to 1,200 Belgian francs, representing a capitalisation of 2.86 to 3.33 billion francs.
Bookbuilding for institutional investors will start on Thursday and retail investors can sign up from June 5 at the latest. A tranche has been reserved for personnel.
Institutional and retail investors can sign up for a maximum 45 percent of the capital, or 1.25 million shares.
There will be no capital increase, it added.
Brantano said it expected turnover to rise by nine to 10 percent each year.
The company is aiming for a pay-out ratio of 50 percent in 1999 against 40 percent in 1996. The expected growth of its dividend was estimated at 60 percent for the 1997-1999 period.
